scoring_justification: Full recompute from raw mode-solver outputs is infeasible in the lightweight verifier sandbox; we compare the agent's reported scalars to the paper's gold within realistic tolerances that accommodate legitimate re-implementation spread (result-level compare).

hidden_assets.purpose: Provide gold values for the four scalar quantities (degenerate pump wavelength and its sensitivities) that the agent must reproduce.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper-reported numbers in Table I (∂λp0/∂dAlox = -3.5 nm/%, ∂λp0/∂dGaAs = +5.2 nm/%) and Fig. 17/associated text (∂λp0/∂T = 0.133 nm/K), with λp0 ≈ 1065 nm stated in the abstract and confirmed by the degeneracy condition in Fig. 3.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's numerical results; the reference solve.sh writes exactly these values to guarantee the oracle yields full reward.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The numbers are the paper's own published results, not invented; they are the only authoritative reference for this reproduction.

dlambda_dGaAs.unit: nm per 1% relative GaAs thickness change

dlambda_dAlox.unit: nm per 1% relative AlOx thickness change

outputs.description: Computed degenerate pump wavelength and its sensitivities to GaAs layer thickness, AlOx layer thickness, and temperature.

output_contract.notes: The four quantities are scored by comparison against the paper-reported values within tolerances (result-level compare, T0).
